heading: Dashboard
description: See all your AI agents at a glance. Status badges, diff stats, tags, and categories give you a complete picture without opening a single terminal.
alt: Dashboard showing status badges, diff stats, tags, and approvals for all agents at a glance

heading: Live Terminal Streaming
description: Full xterm.js terminal per session with real-time output streaming. Attach and reprompt any agent without leaving the browser.
alt: A session open on its live terminal tab, showing the agent output streaming in real time

heading: Browser Element Inspector
description: While watching an agent's browser in the Browser tab, click Inspect, then click any element in the live view.
alt: A session open on its Browser tab, where page elements can be inspected and sent to the agent

heading: Diff Viewer
description: Per-session git diff with VCS context. See exactly what each agent has changed before you approve or merge.
alt: A session open on its diff tab, listing the files the agent changed with added and removed lines

heading: Notifications
description: Real-time alerts when agents need attention — approvals pending, sessions paused, or errors detected — without polling.
alt: The notifications page listing alerts for agents that need attention, with an unread count

heading: Instant Search
description: Type to filter sessions in real time across titles, paths, branches, and tags. "payment" narrows 6 agents down to 2 immediately.
alt: Instant search narrowing the session list from 6 agents down to 2 as the query "payment" is typed

heading: Status Filtering
description: Filter by status to surface agents that need your attention — spot every Needs Approval gate without scrolling through the full list.
alt: Status filter showing every session with a Needs Approval gate, with other statuses hidden

heading: Tag-Based Grouping
description: Switch between 8 grouping strategies — tag, category, status, branch, path, program, session type, or flat list. A single session can appear under multiple tags simultaneously.
alt: Sessions grouped by tag, with a single session appearing under more than one tag group

heading: Bulk Actions
description: Select multiple sessions and act on them together — pause, resume, delete, or tag in one operation.
alt: Select mode on the session list with the bulk action toolbar for pausing, resuming and tagging several sessions at once

heading: Review Queue
description: Structured triage for every pending agent action. Review diffs and approve or reject before anything reaches your codebase.
alt: Review Queue listing pending agent actions with diffs ready to approve or reject before they reach the codebase

heading: Auto-Approval Rules
description: 100+ built-in rules block dangerous operations automatically. Read-only commands, safe git operations, and common dev tasks are pre-approved out of the box.
alt: List of 100+ built-in auto-approval rules covering read-only commands, safe git operations, and common dev tasks

heading: Custom Rules
description: Teach Stapler Squad what's always safe for your project. Add a pattern like ^git log once and never review it again.
alt: Adding a custom approval-rule pattern like ^git log so it is never flagged for manual review again

heading: Approval Analytics
description: Visualise decision trends and classifier performance over time. See which rules fire most, how often agents are approved vs. blocked, and where your review time is going.
alt: The Approval Analytics section showing how automatic rules decided past approval requests

heading: History Search
description: Searchable, filterable record of every agent action across all sessions. Filter by session, time range, action type, or free-text search to find exactly what happened and when.
alt: The history browser with full-text search across past agent conversations

heading: Logs Viewer
description: Live-tail application logs with time range picker, multi-select filters, export, and density controls. No need to SSH in to debug an agent.
alt: The application logs page with time range, export and density controls

heading: Config Viewer
description: Inspect your current Stapler Squad configuration directly from the UI — no hunting for JSON files.
alt: The configuration page showing the current settings sections

heading: Parallel Fan-Out
description: Run one prompt across 2–5 isolated worktree sessions, compare their diffs side by side, and merge the best one.
alt: Three variants of the same task side by side so one can be picked as the winner

heading: Isolated Git Workspaces
description: Every agent gets its own git worktree. No branch conflicts, no dirty state bleed between sessions. Merge when you're ready.
alt: Each agent session running in its own isolated git worktree with no branch conflicts between sessions
